line_items.reasoning: FDX delivered full-year adjusted EPS towards the higher end of the original $17.00–$18.50 range (up 19% YoY), exceeding the narrowed guidance midpoint and fulfilling the 'above midpoint' commitment despite revenue headwinds.
Full-year revenue came in down ~3% (~$2.5B), consistent with the guided 'low single-digit percentage decline' assumption for the full year.
FDX hit its CapEx-to-revenue target of <6.5% one year ahead of schedule, and with revenue down ~3%, actual CapEx likely came in at or below the already-lowered $5.4B guidance.

Ground delivered record adjusted operating income with margin expansion (a beat vs. guided improvement), and Freight margins expanded 220 bps despite soft demand (a beat); however, Express adjusted operating income fell $92M with margins down 90 bps in Q4, worse than the guided 'modest YoY adjusted margin contraction.'
FDX returned $2.5B in share repurchases as guided, but also delivered $500M above the original repurchase plan when including the full FY24 program, exceeding the $500M Q4 repurchase commitment.
